label: intro
narration: Video 4: RobOS Agents Manager. One hub for all your AI coding agents — Codex, GitHub Copilot, and Claude Code.

label: codex-overview
narration: Codex is up and running. Two active sessions are listed — real conversations from prior work, ready to resume.

label: sessions
narration: Each session shows the last message. Dana can see exactly what was asked and jump back in at any point.

label: flags
narration: Clicking the options arrow opens the launch flags panel. Every configurable setting for the agent is surfaced here.

label: flags-detail
narration: Yolo mode bypasses pull request creation. Model lets Dana pick the underlying LLM. Working directory anchors the agent to a specific codebase.

label: copilot
narration: Switching to GitHub Copilot. It's already connected — previous sessions appear immediately.

label: copilot-session
narration: The session list carries over between runs. Dana can resume from exactly where she left off without re-explaining context.

label: copilot-terminal
narration: Opening a Copilot terminal launches a live agent shell session. The agent can run commands, browse files, and stream output directly.

label: terminal-run
narration: The terminal stays open alongside the Agents panel. Dana can watch the agent work without switching windows.

label: browser-auth
narration: GitHub's access confirmation page opens in the browser. The device code from the terminal matches — Dana clicks Authorize.

label: connected
narration: Authentication confirmed. Copilot is back online. Sessions and status refresh automatically.

label: explore
narration: Dana explores the panel — status badge, session list, and action buttons are all visible at a glance.

label: logout
narration: She clicks Logout to show the full authentication flow. The status updates immediately to not logged in.

label: relogin-browser
narration: The browser shows the Copilot CLI authorization page. GitHub asks to confirm the requested access scopes.

label: auth-terminal
narration: The device code is visible in the terminal. The login flow is transparent — no hidden configuration.

label: cwd-picker
narration: Finally, the working directory chooser. Dana opens a native file picker to set where the next agent session will run.

label: cwd-selected
narration: Folder selected. The agent will start grounded in that directory — no path typing, no guessing.

label: outro
narration: Agents Manager is a unified control plane for AI development. Login, configure, launch, and manage — three agents, one panel.
